description: Fetch forward consensus revenue/EPS/EBITDA estimates, management guidance ranges, and estimate-revision percentages for one exact Bullrun ticker. Also derives simple forward P/E and PEG-style context from the latest close when EPS estimates are available. Read-only. Successful results include an optional platformLink for continuing this research or reviewing the exact saved draft in Bullrun. When useful, present its descriptive link and respect its description of any settings not carried over.

periodType.description: Return annual estimates, quarterly estimates, or both.

ticker.description: The ticker exactly as listed on Bullrun, e.g. "AAPL", "CRWD", "SPGI".

name: get_forward_estimates
title: Get forward estimates
